follow-up time: Not specified, but patients were followed up to assess uterine function and occurrence of subsequent pregnancies
cohort: 54 women with cesarean scar pregnancy who underwent uterine artery embolization between January 2007 and September 2012 at the Peking University People's Hospital
finding: Uterine artery embolization combined with suction curettage is an effective and safe conservative treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy, resulting in successful treatment, restoration of uterine function, and possibility of subsequent pregnancies without severe complications.
